Strictly inside means x from -4 to 4 (9 values) and y from -3 to 3 (7 values), giving 9 × 7 = 63 points.

Solution A counts only the first quadrant (x 1–4, y 1–3 gives 12) and multiplies by 4, giving 48. This omits the points on the axes (x = 0 or y = 0), so it is wrong.

Solution B starts from an incorrect larger rectangle and subtracts an incorrect boundary count, giving 109. This is also wrong.

Neither is correct. The correct answer is 63. Since I must choose, I pick the one closer to the correct count: A (48 vs 109 — A is off by 15, B is off by 46).

WINNER: A
